properties.name_zh: 京张午间服务主线·南段
properties.name_en: Jing-Zhang Noon Service Spine - South Segment
properties.service_scope_note: Provides conceptual corridor connection, fixed route recognition, Jing-Zhang sequence and AI-OFF wayfinding only; it is outside the <=400 m Level 1 SLA-service-zone target.
properties.design_role: connects the Dazhongsi interface to the AI Origin interface as a conceptual heritage-park walking spine
properties.physical_connection_rule: Propose a legible uninterrupted route and fixed Jing-Zhang sequence; it does not claim installed shade, seats, water or a surveyed accessible path.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI may provide optional arrival, heat and maintenance prompts, never route access as a prerequisite.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Fixed route recognition and human-help references remain the public baseline when screens or AI are unavailable.
properties.failure_response: If a lawful public path cannot be confirmed, remove the affected route claim; never substitute dynamic guidance for physical access or claim Level 1 SLA continuity.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Railway-style continuity is expressed through legible direction, maintainable markers and accountable handover rather than a decorative heritage object.

properties.name_zh: 京张午间服务主线·原点段
properties.name_en: Jing-Zhang Noon Service Spine - Origin Segment
properties.service_scope_note: Within the AI Origin Level 1 service zone, primary and secondary concept support points are arranged to a <=400 m spacing design target subject to legal, accessible field-route verification.
properties.design_role: forms the public-culture and AI-explanation segment inside the provisional AI Origin area
properties.physical_connection_rule: Organize frontage, shade/planting reservation, stopping/service band and a pedestrian clear zone as separate conceptual bands.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI can translate, explain and summarize feedback from the civic room without replacing physical information.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Bilingual static information, seating reservations and human enquiry remain usable without a phone or screen.
properties.failure_response: If a clearway, entry or maintenance responsibility is unconfirmed, downgrade the service claim and direct users to a confirmed public edge.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Public engineering knowledge becomes a readable sequence of direction, maintenance and shared access.

properties.name_zh: 京张午间服务主线·北向跨区连接段
properties.name_en: Jing-Zhang Noon Service Spine - North Inter-Zone Connector
properties.service_scope_note: Provides conceptual corridor connection, fixed route recognition, Jing-Zhang sequence and AI-OFF wayfinding only; it is outside the <=400 m Level 1 SLA-service-zone target.
properties.design_role: connects the AI Origin public-culture segment to the Zhongzhiyuan research-test interface across the provisional corridor
properties.physical_connection_rule: Propose fixed directional continuity between public knowledge and research-test interfaces without asserting a constructed facility.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI may advise on conditions but cannot be required to understand or enter the route.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Static wayfinding and visible human-help references preserve orientation when AI is unavailable.
properties.failure_response: Treat access uncertainty as a route break, not as an AI-routing problem; the connector does not claim Level 1 service spacing.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: The route translates linear railway continuity into a contemporary, maintainable public connection.

properties.service_scope_note: Part of the Zhongzhiyuan Level 1 service zone; <=400 m is a concept design target to be checked on a legal, accessible field route.
properties.design_role: forms the north-south service-zone spine between the Zhongzhiyuan entry interface and research-test porch without asserting an existing pedestrian facility
properties.physical_connection_rule: Keep the pedestrian clear zone distinct from observation, safety-buffer and controlled-test layers.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI may publish a test-status notice outside the clearway and cannot authorize public entry into a controlled layer.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: A fixed bypass, threshold marker and F01 human-support link remain available with testing and AI both off.
properties.failure_response: If the buffer cannot protect the clearway or no accountable operator exists, stop the test interface and retain public walking only.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Engineering reliability is applied as separation of operational movement, public movement and maintenance responsibility.

properties.name_zh: 京张午间服务主线·众智园段
properties.service_scope_note: Within the Zhongzhiyuan Level 1 service zone, primary and secondary concept support points are arranged to a <=400 m spacing design target subject to legal, accessible field-route verification.
properties.design_role: forms an east-west research-test interface from the main axis without asserting an existing campus edge
properties.physical_connection_rule: Sequence public clearway, observation/stay edge, physical safety buffer and controlled test layer without assuming a present-day campus edge.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: Test results or status may be shown as optional interpretation from the controlled side of the buffer.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Public movement, observation and F01 handoff remain readable if the test system is stopped.
properties.failure_response: Test occupation, missing safety buffer, absent permit or absent responsible role stops the display and returns the interface to public walking and enquiry.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Verification, safe separation and named maintenance responsibility turn railway engineering discipline into a test-interface rule.

properties.service_scope_note: Within the Zhongzhiyuan Level 1 service zone, primary and secondary concept support points are arranged to a <=400 m spacing design target subject to legal, accessible field-route verification.
properties.design_role: links the main axis to a conceptual public-entry and research-test interface without asserting an existing gate
properties.physical_connection_rule: A public threshold leads to a readable porch and fixed bypass; controlled activity remains beyond the safety buffer.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: Optional AI guidance can explain test status but never determines whether a visitor can find the public route.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: A durable bilingual marker and F01 human support provide no-phone entry and exit orientation.
properties.failure_response: If an entry cannot be publicly opened or signed, remove the entry claim and keep users on the confirmed main-spine edge.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: The threshold makes a public connection legible before it becomes technically intelligent.

properties.service_scope_note: Within the AI Origin Level 1 service zone, primary and secondary concept support points are arranged to a <=400 m spacing design target subject to legal, accessible field-route verification.
properties.design_role: links the main axis to a conceptual bilingual public-entry forecourt and offline information interface
properties.physical_connection_rule: A low-threshold forecourt connects static bilingual information to seating, discussion and the lateral civic route.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: Translation and interpretation are optional layers after physical information is available.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Visitors can enter, read, ask and leave through a fixed sign, public route and F02 support without an account, phone or screen.
properties.failure_response: If public opening or maintenance is unconfirmed, relocate the information interface to a confirmed public edge and remove the entry claim.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Railway public information becomes a human-readable entry sequence rather than a screen-led exhibition.

properties.service_scope_note: Within the Dazhongsi Level 1 service zone, primary and secondary concept support points are arranged to a <=400 m spacing design target subject to legal, accessible field-route verification.
properties.design_role: links the main axis to a conceptual station-facing arrival interface; no existing station exit or crossing is asserted
properties.physical_connection_rule: Arrange arrival, orientation, short stay, crossing/accessibility decision and service frontage as an ordered public chain.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI may assist with flows or service timing but cannot substitute for a lawful crossing, visible alternative or human help.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: F04, fixed transfer signs and a marked alternative retain route understanding during AI-off operation.
properties.failure_response: If the station-facing interface, crossing or accessible detour is not verified, reroute to a confirmed public edge or suspend the rail-connection claim.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Arrival, transfer and directional clarity translate railway service reliability into the everyday urban market interface.

properties.service_scope_note: Within the AI Origin Level 1 service zone, primary and secondary concept support points are arranged to a <=400 m spacing design target subject to legal, accessible field-route verification.
properties.design_role: creates a conceptual east-west link between the main axis, public-entry interface and the broader slow-mobility network
properties.physical_connection_rule: Provide a lateral route that ties the entry, sitting/discussion room and crossing decision to the main spine.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI feedback may be gathered at the civic room but must not gate lateral movement.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Static directional information and F03 human-help reference keep the lateral route readable without digital services.
properties.failure_response: If the crossing or lateral public edge is unavailable, state the break and direct users only along confirmed alternatives.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Cross-connections make a linear heritage route useful as a shared public network.

properties.service_scope_note: Within the AI Origin Level 1 service zone, this interface supports fixed wayfinding and a future verified crossing decision; it does not assert an existing crossing.
properties.design_role: marks a place where crossing waiting and an accessible alternative should be designed; it is not an observed crossing
properties.physical_connection_rule: Locate waiting, physical orientation and a future measured accessible alternative outside the walking clear zone.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI may display conditions only after a physical crossing decision and human fallback are present.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: A fixed crossing notice and F03 help remain available without dynamic guidance.
properties.failure_response: No signal, sightline, legal status or accessible condition is assumed; unresolved risk requires reroute or removal of the crossing claim.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Clear directional decisions and responsible fallback turn a potential break into an accountable public interface.

properties.name_zh: 大钟寺南侧过街断点段
properties.service_scope_note: Within the Dazhongsi Level 1 service zone, this interface supports fixed wayfinding and a future verified crossing decision; it does not assert an existing crossing.
properties.design_role: marks a conceptual crossing and detour decision point for the transit-business arrival chain
properties.physical_connection_rule: Place a decision point before the service frontage with waiting space outside the clearway and an independently measured accessible alternative.
properties.intelligent_connection_rule: AI may give optional disruption alerts but cannot manufacture a safe crossing or accessible detour.
properties.resilient_connection_rule: Fixed detour information and F05 human support preserve an understandable route when AI is off.
properties.failure_response: Unsafe crossing, unacceptable detour or missing public entry suspends the continuous-transfer claim and triggers a signed alternative or stop.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: Reliable transfer is a spatial obligation: a route is not complete until its failure path is legible.
